note: Governance-only bridge between the runtime evidence ledger (which keys services by NAME, e.g. 'weather-service') and the capability registry (which keys services by PATH, e.g. 'services/weather-service/main.py'). This file alone changes NOTHING: it neither sets runtime_verified nor is trusted to. Propagation to a capability is allowed only by a separate, evidence-gated step and only when valid Step-3 FUNCTIONAL evidence (bound to SHA + environment + time + probe kind) covers that capability's declared requirements. Matching is by explicit declared identity only — never by approximate name or substring. Everything is fail-closed.
